prisma:query SELECT "public"."Client"."id", "public"."Client"."name", "public"."Client"."email", "public"."Client"."phone", "public"."Client"."company", "public"."Client"."address", "public"."Client"."createdAt", "public"."Client"."updatedAt", "public"."Client"."deletedAt", "public"."Client"."createdById", "public"."Client"."updatedById", "public"."Client"."isActive" FROM "public"."Client" WHERE "public"."Client"."deletedAt" IS NULL ORDER BY "public"."Client"."name" ASC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2
